alcohol.quote:
32. (1) No person shall sell by retail, or offer for sale by retail, any 
intoxicating liquor whether for consumption on or off the premises of 
the vendor except under and in accordance with a licence issued under 
this Part and in a place specified in such licence: 
 
(a) public house licences—for the sale by retail of intoxicating 
liquors, excluding toddy, for consumption on the premises 
or at the place where they are sold; 
 
(b) beer house licences—for the sale by retail of beer for 
consumption on the premises or at the place where it is 
sold: provided that the holders of public house licences are 
exempted from beer house licences; 
 
(c) retail shop licences—for the sale by retail of intoxicating
alcohol.source_locator: Section 32(1) retail sale to be licensed; section 35(1) licence classes

translation_review.gloss: Section 32(1): no person may sell by retail, or offer for retail sale, intoxicating liquor for consumption on or off the premises except under and in accordance with a licence issued under this Part and in a place specified in the licence. Section 35(1) lists public house, beer house, retail shop and wholesale dealer licences.
translation_review.review: The decisive words are 'except under and in accordance with a licence' and 'in a place specified in such licence'. No licence is granted by these sections; they route the question to the licence holder and the licensed premises.

value.observed_rule: Selling or serving alcohol at a private event needs a licence held for the premises; a hotel bar licence and an event licence are separate questions.
value.unknown: Who holds the licence for each room, whether it covers a 50-person private event, and the permitted serving hours.
value.venue_level: A bar or restaurant mention is context, not event permission: alcohol_service stays unknown unless the operator's event terms answer the question, and service is never assumed.

verification_questions: Ask each venue who holds the licence, whether it covers a closed private event, and the permitted serving hours to 21:00.

food.quote:
Activity
56103
Fast-food restaurants
Activity
“food premises” means premises used for or in conection with the
preparation, preservation, packaging, storage, conveyance,
distribution or sale of any food, or the relabelling, reprocessing or
reconditioning of any food;
food.source_locator: MSIC 56210 event/food caterers; definition of 'food premises'

translation_review.gloss: Event and food caterers are a listed food activity, and 'food premises' means premises used for or in connection with the preparation, preservation, packaging, storage, conveyance, distribution or sale of food.
translation_review.review: The definition makes a caterer's kitchen a food premises; it does not approve a caterer for a particular venue or permit outside catering.

value.observed_rule: Catering is a licensed food activity; which caterers a venue approves is a separate contract question.
value.unknown: Which caterers each venue approves, whether external catering is allowed, and what surcharge applies.
value.venue_level: catering, food_service and delivery_allowed stay unknown on all 30 rooms.

verification_questions: Confirm the venue's approved caterers, their food-premises registration and any external-catering fee.

language.quote:
2. Bahasa kebangsaan digunakan bagi maksud-maksud rasmi. 
dalam Perkara 152 (1) Perlembagaan berhubungan dengan 
mana-mana bahasa lain dan bahasa mana-mana kaum lain 
dalam Malaysia bahasa kebangsaan hendaklah digunakan bagi 
maksud-maksud rasmi. 
[Akta 7/67,s.2]

translation_review.gloss: Except as provided in this Act and subject to the safeguards in Article 152(1) of the Constitution for other languages, the national language shall be used for official purposes.
translation_review.review: 'Maksud-maksud rasmi' means official purposes. The section does not name a private event organiser or a commercial venue, so no language duty is read onto the page or the event from this Act.

value.observed_rule: The national language is required for official purposes; the Act's scope does not name private commercial events.
value.unknown: Whether venue staff and AV crew work in English or Malay, and whether attendee-facing signage needs a Malay version.
value.venue_level: Every language_support row is a checked unknown; the page is English with Malay and Chinese names kept.

verification_questions: Confirm the working language of venue staff, signage and AV support.

Each venue is supported by premium amenities and thoughtfully designed interiors, and our dedicated Community Manager ensures every detail runs smoothly. Whether you're looking for a small event space for a birthday party or a larger event space for a business gathering, Colony sets the stage for unforgettable experiences across KL and the Klang Valley.

verification_questions: Confirm the private-event start, end and staffing hours for a 09:00 start.
Confirm who holds the licence for this room, whether it covers a closed 50-person private event, and the permitted serving hours to 21:00.

declared_gaps.text: Three records carry an area pin only: Colony Event Lounge at KL Eco City and Common Ground KL Eco City sit in the KL Eco City development (no OSM point exists for Menara 2), and WSPACE Event Space 50 sits in Mid Valley City because Centrepoint North has no OSM point.

Three records carry a street pin only: The Hive Bukit KL (only the expressway resolves; the operator prints No.68 at Taman Bukit), The Co. (its site now serves an unrelated lottery page, so the street comes from a 2016 listing at The Row, Jalan Doraisamy), and Common Ground Ampang (only Jalan Kolam Air Lama resolves; the site is in Selangor).

No record reaches exact_venue with a proven room entrance: the operator pages that print addresses print building or level, never a door, and no venue was visited. Three venue-level POIs (APW Bangsar, MATRADE MECC, Sunway Pyramid Convention Centre) are labelled exact_venue because the geocoder returns the venue itself, not a room.

Thirty-one of 55 records still carry no cleared room photograph, and the eight records that gained one use operator assets hotlinked with attribution because the pages publish no separate licence text. Every withheld record names the pages checked; no stock, look-alike or unlicensed image is used.
The WSPACE Mid Valley asset the operator serves for its event space is named Level 8 while the contact page prints Level 27 Penthouse; the floor conflict is recorded and no WSPACE photo is stored.

The BKPP primary schedule PDF (kabinet.gov.my/storage/2026/08/HKA_2027.pdf) was unreachable from this host on 2026-11-26: https, http and the bare host all timed out. The Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur column therefore rests on three independent reproductions (kalendar.ecentral.my, toolneko, malaysiakalendar) and the 21 stored public rows keep their subject-to-announcement caveat for the eight Islamic dates.

The KPM Kalendar Akademik Tahun 2027 PDF is image-only (111 extractable characters over 7 pages), so Lampiran B and C were read by OCR; the Kumpulan B term table was cross-checked against three independent reproductions of the same circular. Ten single-day KPM festival holidays are stored with the school breaks.

The six-theme matrix ran 66 cells over 11 lanes: Luma’s Kuala Lumpur city page prints 150 Kuala Lumpur mentions and no 2027 date, both alias pages and the Malaysia page carry no 2027 date, the MiraGather payloads name no Kuala Lumpur event, AI Tinkerers’ all-cities page returns 403 and its Kuala Lumpur chapter ends in November 2026, and Meetup returns November-December 2026 editions. Two 2027 Kuala Lumpur events were added from Eventbrite and one Selangor 2027 event was excluded.

One room (WORQ) publishes a bookable day, 8 am to 10 pm, that contains 09:00-21:00; the other 54 records are unknown because their operator pages print no event interval. The clock lines that do exist are office or mall hours (WTC 9.00 am-6.00 pm Mon-Fri, WSPACE 9:00am-6:00pm weekdays, Publika 10:00am-10:00pm) and are recorded as such, not as hire windows.
One provider was used: OpenStreetMap Nominatim. No second geocoder or national address register was queried, and every matched point is derived rather than surveyed.
No venue was contacted and no site visit was made; the visits list stays empty and every open question remains a question rather than a confirmed term.
